name: Fennis Vessor
keeps: what grows on her side of the wall
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: Held that the stars were suns with worlds of their own.
text: Fennis vessor of the thin wall, keeps a door for the 10th tranche, doors 86 to 95. Keeps what grows on her side of the wall. Reads Giordano Bruno.
